title: How to Add a Shortcut in Google Chrome on MacBook – Easy Guide 2026
description:
In this tutorial, you'll learn how to quickly create a shortcut for Google Chrome on your MacBook, simplifying your access to favourite websites. We walk you through the process step-by-step, starting from opening Finder to dragging the Chrome icon to your desktop for easy access.

Additionally, discover how to bookmark your favourite websites directly in Chrome, ensuring that you can navigate to them with ease. Don't forget to hit the like button and subscribe for more Mac and tech tutorials!
